description: This file defines a Backbone class and several functions related to model loading, backbone selection, and model conversion for a RetinaNet object detection framework. It includes class definitions, method implementations, and external module references.

classes.name: Backbone
classes.description: A class that stores information about model backbones, including custom objects and methods for validation and preprocessing.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Returns a RetinaNet model using the specified backbone. Not implemented in this class.

methods.name: download_imagenet
methods.description: Downloads ImageNet weights for the backbone. Not implemented in this class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the backbone string. Not implemented in this class.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Preprocesses an input image for the backbone network. Not implemented in this class.
